modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cinematic: Smooth zoom with cinematic black bars and per-frame easing.
cinematiczoom.config.title: Cinematic Zoom - Settings
cinematiczoom.option.cinematic_starting_: Magnification applied when cinematic zoom starts. 1× shows black bars without zoom.
cinematiczoom.option.regular_starting_zo: Magnification applied when regular zoom starts.
cinematiczoom.option.scale_sensitivity.t: Scale down mouse sensitivity proportionally with zoom level so the view remains smooth and easy to control.
cinematiczoom.option.bars_percent.toolti: Percent of screen height for each bar (top and bottom). 0–50%.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_in_ms.tooltip: Time in milliseconds to animate zooming in. 0 disables the animation.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_out_ms.tooltip: Time in milliseconds to animate zooming out. 0 disables the animation.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_in_curve.toolt: Easing curve applied when zooming in.
cinematiczoom.option.zoom_out_curve.tool: Easing curve applied when zooming out.
cinematiczoom.option.mouse_wheel_enabled: Allow adjusting zoom level with the mouse wheel while holding either zoom key.
cinematiczoom.option.discrete_scroll.too: Steps zoom level by uniform magnification increments (e.g. +1× per notch) so scrolling feels linear and predictable.
cinematiczoom.option.discrete_scroll_ste: Magnification amount to add or subtract with each scroll wheel notch when discrete scrolling is enabled.
cinematiczoom.option.hide_hud.tooltip: Temporarily enables F1-like mode to hide HUD and crosshair during zoom.
cinematiczoom.option.cinematic_cam.toolt: Temporarily enables smooth camera (cinematic camera) during zoom.
cinematiczoom.option.toggle_mode.tooltip: Press to toggle zoom on/off instead of holding the key.
